settings.heroIntro: I design and build complete web products — from the interface to the database. React and Next.js on the front, Firebase and Supabase behind it, plus the APIs, CRMs and internal systems that keep a business running.
settings.aboutStatement: I build web products that work as hard as you do.
aboutBio: I'm Yousry — a full-stack developer who builds websites and the systems behind them for businesses that want more than a pretty page.

My core is the web platform itself: fast, accessible, SEO-ready interfaces written by hand — no bloated templates, no page builders. React and Next.js on the front, Firebase and Supabase on the back, with auth, storage and realtime wired up properly.

On top of that I build the unglamorous things that actually run a company: CRMs, dashboards, admin panels and custom internal systems that replace spreadsheets and disconnected tools — so a business can move from idea to working product without the guesswork.
